name: Windrose Dedicated Server
description: Install the Windrose dedicated server through SteamCMD and launch its native Windows server executable directly.
known_limitations: Windrose currently has no reviewed GameNode configuration adapter: the game owns JSON files whose world path and generated identifiers must remain consistent.
The server primarily uses Steam networking/NAT traversal. Direct-IP mode and its port are configured manually in ServerDescription.json.
WorldDescription.json is generated below a versioned world directory and must not be edited through a generic file adapter.
Automatic updates, backups, world migration, and the R5 world updater are outside this template.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Name shown for the Windrose server.

variables.name: Password protection
variables.description: Whether Windrose requires the configured password.

variables.name: Direct connection
variables.description: Enable Windrose direct-IP mode instead of relying on Steam networking.

variables.name: Direct connection port
variables.description: TCP and UDP port used when direct-IP mode is enabled.

config_files.description: Generated server identity, invite/password, selected world, player cap, and optional direct-connection settings.

requirements.description: The current Steam dedicated-server manifest advertises Windows only.
Managed anonymous SteamCMD installation is required.
The dedicated server is a 64-bit Windows executable.

help.summary: GameNode installs SteamCMD App ID 4129620 and launches WindroseServer.exe with -log.
notes: Run the server once before configuring its generated R5 JSON files.
Direct-IP mode and its TCP/UDP port are optional Windrose settings and are not registered until a reviewed adapter exists.

findings.summary: Windrose configuration is JSON with generated world identifiers; no safe compiled JSON adapter exists in the current GameNode adapter set.
The default server uses Steam networking/NAT traversal; direct-IP ports are configured in ServerDescription.json and are not declared as fixed GameNode ports.

prerequisites: Network access to Steam content servers during installation
The Windrose client and dedicated server versions must stay matched
